scope: Still-unexecuted phases only; metadata transport and ownership/accounting design. No replacement verifier, source executable, activation, process or qualification is produced.

unchanged_contract.scientific_sources: Existing complete semantic/static verifier and all point/domain/body/pool semantics remain unchanged; any later wrapper implementation requires a separate source freeze and independent review.
unchanged: Complete immutable evidence and independent semantic checking

compact_worker_status_interface.producer: Same independently reviewed worker after its unchanged full semantic audit, full JSON serialization/close, streamed final-artifact hash and postserialization plan-byte verification.

required_bindings.full_audit_pin: Exact declared path, SHA256 and full byte count of the closed immutable full static-result JSON.
required_bindings.plan_pin: Exact frozen actual per-phase plan, not an uninstantiated source template.
required_bindings.activation_pin: Separately ROOT-created actual activation; design does not create one.
required_bindings.selector_and_stage: Literal predeclared selector and static phase.

compact_worker_status_interface.count_projection: Emit complete group count derived from the same groups_checked array; preserve full groups, census, domain streams, source receipts and mutation controls in the full audit JSON.
compact_worker_status_interface.status_authority: A compact status is a transport projection of an actual full audit. It creates no additional semantic acceptance and cannot replace the full audit or its independent verifier.
write_order: Hash its bytes in a bounded stream and verify exact plan/source bytes
Write and close compact worker status
Exit; direct owner waits/reaps before consuming status
compact_worker_status_interface.failure_rule: Missing/truncated/hash-mismatched/wrong-plan/wrong-worker/stale compact status is UNKNOWN. A semantic pass never overrides resource failure. No retry, inferred successful suffix or full-json fallback decode in metadata parents.

streamed_parent_transport.owner: Read compact status only. Stream hash full audit file once to match status pin; do not decode full audit JSON to read scalar status. Own result hashing, compact decode, serialization, close, exit and reap are charged.
streamed_parent_transport.dispatcher: Read compact owner receipt and exact compact worker status; stream each distinct full audit/plan/worker artifact to verify pins with a phase-local pin cache keyed by literal declared path plus immutable pin, never by filename alone. No repeated huge audit decode.
streamed_parent_transport.launcher: Read compact final dispatcher status/receipt and compare exact receipt pins after dispatcher exit/reap; stream required artifacts rather than read_bytes. Its own final receipt/exit costs remain visible to the enclosing ROOT gate.
streamed_parent_transport.mutation_safety: Exclusive immutable output names; preserve literal external/runtime path spelling. Hash cache is valid only within one unchanged exclusive phase. Re-stat before/after stream and reject changed file identity/length; no relaxed pin merely because scalar status agrees.
streamed_parent_transport.receipt_payloads: Keep complete observer/sample tables in separately immutable detailed metadata artifacts. Compact owner/dispatcher/launcher receipts bind them by exact pins and summary maxima/counts. Detailed tables remain inspectable, not silently omitted.
streamed_parent_transport.serialization_accounting: No receipt is final before close and enclosing exit/reap clock qualification. If a provisional envelope is used, retain existing budget/reserve semantics and validate full serialized bytes/postwrite observations rather than introducing an unmeasured reserve.
streamed_parent_transport.memory_scope: Bounded byte chunks and compact fields reduce avoidable metadata allocations; this is a prospective design claim, not measured resource improvement or new qualification.

individually_owned_observers.topology: Launcher owns one dispatcher; dispatcher owns one phase owner; phase owner owns one scientific worker. Each sampling process is a separately tracked direct child of its calling wrapper, with no use of cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN as a ps-only measurement.
individually_owned_observers.commands: Exact pinned metadata observer binary and predeclared PID/PPID/PGID/RSS/birth-identity fields only. No process command lines or unrelated contents. No actual observer is launched in this task.
individually_owned_observers.clock_domain: Start before spawn, include startup, pipe draining, parsing, hashing, timeout handling, close, terminal wait/reap and receipt close. The caller continues its own complete outer clock through observer work and enclosing receipt/exit/reap.
individually_owned_observers.reaping: Track each process handle and birth identity. Reap every observer exactly once, including timeout/parse-error/cancellation. Never send a signal to a historical PID/process group after its terminal child is reaped. Any unresolved descendant or unaccounted observer is UNKNOWN.
individually_owned_observers.boundedness: Reuse unchanged enclosing time/memory limits and already frozen applicable observer/stream limits. Source implementation must declare deterministic phase-local observation scheduling and cap metadata memory within those limits, not obtain larger scientific budgets.
individually_owned_observers.ledger: Preserve per-observer wait4 usage separately. For sequential verified leaf observers, their maximum may bound at most one concurrent observer per caller; observers from different nested callers may coexist and all distinct simultaneous scopes must be represented. Never infer sequentiality merely from a loop name.

platform_semantics_prerequisites.must_verify: Exact ru_maxrss units and semantics for RUSAGE_SELF, direct-child wait4 and the selected ps RSS field on the pinned macOS/Python/binary versions. Record primary platform documentation and separately authorized bounded non-scientific calibration evidence.

Whether direct-child terminal wait4 usage contains reaped descendants; whether RUSAGE_CHILDREN combines maxima or accumulated quantities; fork/exec and short-lived descendants. Specify the accounting domain for each record.
Birth-identity reliability and PID reuse handling, direct-child reaping, ownership traversal, observer leaf behavior, sampling race/error semantics and any unobserved terminated process scope.

What summing RSS/high-water values bounds, including shared pages. Sum independently justified distinct scopes conservatively; do not subtract an alleged overlap without established semantics. A sum of disjoint-scope peaks need not be simultaneous physical RSS.

Coverage from launcher startup/imports to final receipt close/exit/reap; postserialization self/observer peaks and streamed hashing allocations; any measurement observer used to qualify a measurement must itself be owned/charged.

prospective_acceptance_rule: Future separately reviewed executable wrappers may accept only exact-bound full semantic evidence AND complete owned resource/clock/reap acceptance under unchanged caps. If platform scope cannot be established, retain conservative accounting and UNKNOWN. No historical discount/recalculation is permitted here.
future_source_review_controls: Changed full audit bytes with unchanged compact status pin must reject
Correct audit pin but wrong plan/worker/selector must reject
Missing/truncated compact receipt or missing detailed observer artifact must reject
Semantic PASS with nonzero exit/resource UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN
Every observer timeout/cancellation/parse failure must be terminal and reaped
Postwrite/exit memory or clock overrun must invalidate provisional acceptance
Complete all-five qualification stays forbidden while donor-two-guards resource status is UNKNOWN
handoff: ROOT alone may separately author/freeze/review future executable implementation and any separately authorized platform calibration. This design does not activate remaining contexts or authorize another attempt of the executed donor phase.
